<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_SubsequentEventsAbstract', window );"><strong>Subsequent Events [Abstract]</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>

<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_SubsequentEventsTextBlock', window );">Subsequent Events</a></td>
<td class="text"><div style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Note 7. Subsequent Events </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Company evaluated subsequent events through the filing of this Quarterly Report on Form <div style="white-space:nowrap;display:inline;">10-Q,</div> and no events have occurred that require consideration as adjustments to, or disclosures in, the consolidated financial statement, except as noted below. </div><div style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><div style="font-style:italic;display:inline;">Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust and Bylaws </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Effective on July&#160;21, 2026, in connection with the commencement of its private offering, the Company executed the Declaration of Trust, which amended and restated the Company&#8217;s declaration of trust, dated December&#160;23, 2025, and the Company adopted its bylaws. </div><div style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On July&#160;21, 2026, 50 common shares held by HPS were converted into 50 Class&#160;E common shares. </div><div style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><div style="font-style:italic;display:inline;">Election of Trustees </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On July&#160;21, 2026, Faith Rosenfeld, as the sole Trustee of the Company, increased the size of the Board to six members and elected each of Robert F. Cummings, Jr., Lisa Hess, James G. Koman, David Lehman, and Robert Van Dore to the Board to fill the vacancies created by such increase, effective July&#160;21, 2026, after which Ms.&#160;Rosenfeld resigned as Trustee of the Company and the Board reduced its size to five members. The Board also appointed Ms.&#160;Hess and Messrs. Cummings and Van Dore to the audit committee of the Board (the &#8220;Audit Committee&#8221;) and appointed Mr.&#160;Koman as the chairperson of the Board and Mr.Van Dore as the chairperson of the Audit Committee. </div><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;text-align:center"> </div><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><div style="font-style:italic;display:inline;">Distribution Reinvestment Plan and Share Repurchase Plan </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On July&#160;21, 2026, the Company adopted a distribution reinvestment plan and a share repurchase plan. See <div style="font-style:italic;display:inline;">&#8220;Note 3. Equity&#8221;</div> for additional information. </div><div style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><div style="font-style:italic;display:inline;">Related Party Arrangements </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On July&#160;21, 2026, the Company entered into an Advisory Agreement with the Advisor. On July&#160;23, 2026, the Company entered into a Dealer Manager Agreement and an Administration Agreement with the Dealer Manager and the Administrator, respectively. See <div style="font-style:italic;display:inline;">&#8220;Note 4. Related Party Transactions&#8221;</div> for additional information. </div><span></span>
</td>
</tr>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for significant events or transactions that occurred after the balance sheet date through the date the financial statements were issued or the date the financial statements were available to be issued. Examples include: the sale of a capital stock issue, purchase of a business, settlement of litigation, catastrophic loss, significant foreign exchange rate changes, loans to insiders or affiliates, and transactions not in the ordinary course of business.</p></div>
